source: Owner follow-up immediately after the detailed CombatAI01 plan handoff
owner_message_original: Это будет все в задачи оформлено?
owner_message_english_translation: Will all of this be formalized as tasks?
decision: Formalize the delivered CombatAI01 implementation plan in the existing Multica project as a coordination parent and bounded backlog implementation tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
interpretation: The controller treats the follow-up as a request to prepare the tasks described in the plan. This authorizes task preparation, not execution.
scope: Create a parent under MSQ-67, core packages CAI-00 through CAI-08 and CAI-10/11, and separate integration packages CAI-09A/B/C/D1/D2. Split CAI-09D into disarming and wound-gesture integration so the existing independent MSQ-99 and MSQ-100 mechanics do not block each other.
execution_boundary: All new tasks remain backlog and unassigned, with no runs. Use administrative services only, --no-start for description changes and the existing dedicated metadata API. Do not start a task runtime or dispatch implementation/review execution from these new issues.
dependencies: Keep the core delivery and profiling independent of future powers/destruction. Record conditional integrated acceptance separately. Preserve existing task status, stage, assignment, descriptions and dependency metadata; MSQ-70's direct delivered candidate remains documented separately from its historical backlog state.
supersedes: CombatAI01-Planning01's no-task-creation boundary only. Its no-implementation boundary, design assumptions and preservation requirements remain.
preservation: Preserve owner edits, current gameplay/editor state, existing sources and historical planning/review evidence. Commit the verified task setup locally before handoff.
